###############################################################
# 1. Introduction
###############################################################

The purpose of this document is to build the reference spectral library of the
HUMAN Metabolomics Ring Trial using exclusively the Bioconductor
RforMassSpectrometry ecosystem.

The final library will be stored as a `CompDb` SQLite database containing

- compound annotations,
- MS/MS spectra,
- acquisition metadata,
- laboratory-specific metadata.

The resulting database constitutes the master representation of the Ring Trial
spectral library and can later be exported to external formats such as MSP or
MassBank.

The workflow implemented in this document follows the strategy proposed in the
official `CompoundDb` vignette while adapting it to the specific needs of the
Ring Trial.

###############################################################
# 7. Locate mzML files
###############################################################

```{r}

find_mzml_file <-
function(lab,
         mzml_name,
         polarity,
         mzml_dirs){
    if(lab == "afekta"){
        directory <- mzml_dirs$AFEKTA
    }
    else if(lab == "hmgu"){
        directory <- mzml_dirs$HMGU
    }
    else if(lab == "cembio"){
        directory <-
            ifelse(
                polarity == "pos",
                mzml_dirs$CEMBIO_POS,
                mzml_dirs$CEMBIO_NEG
            )
    }
    else{
        stop(
            paste(
                "Unknown laboratory:",
                lab
            )
        )
    }
    candidate <-
        file.path(
            directory,
            paste0(
                mzml_name
            )
        )
    if(!file.exists(candidate)){
        stop(
            paste(
                "File not found:",
                candidate
            )
        )
    }
    candidate
}

```

```{r}

# Absolute mzML path

provenance$file <- gsub(
    "Human_Endosome",
    "Human Endosome",
    provenance$file
)

provenance <- provenance |>
    dplyr::filter(lab != "icl")

provenance$mzml_path <-
    purrr::pmap_chr(
        list(
            provenance$lab,
            provenance$file,
            provenance$polarity
        ),
        find_mzml_file,
        mzml_dirs = mzml_dirs
    )

head(provenance$mzml_path)

```

###############################################################
# 8. Split provenance table by mzML file
###############################################################

```{r}

provenance_split <-
    split(
        provenance,
        provenance$mzml_path
    )

length(provenance_split)

```

###############################################################
# 9. Read mzML
###############################################################

```{r}

read_mzml <- function(file){
    Spectra(
        file,
        backend = MsBackendMzR()
    )
}

```

###############################################################
# 10. Extract required scans
###############################################################

```{r}

extract_required_spectra <-
function(sp, provenance_subset) {
    scan_numbers <- provenance_subset$acquisition_num
    idx <- match(
        scan_numbers,
        acquisitionNum(sp)
    )
    if (anyNA(idx)) {
        missing_scans <- scan_numbers[is.na(idx)]
        mzml_file <- unique(provenance_subset$file)
        stop(
            "In file ", mzml_file,
            " the following acquisition numbers were not found: ",
            paste(missing_scans, collapse = ", ")
        )
    }
    sp <- sp[idx]
    sp
}

```

###############################################################
# 11. Read all mzML files
###############################################################

```{r}

spectra_list <- vector(
    "list",
    length(provenance_split)
)

names(spectra_list) <-
    names(provenance_split)

# Read spectra

for(i in seq_along(provenance_split)){
    message(
        "Reading ",
        basename(
            names(provenance_split)[i]
        )
    )
    prov <-
        provenance_split[[i]]
    sp <-
        read_mzml(
            unique(
                prov$mzml_path
            )
        )
    sp <-
        extract_required_spectra(
            sp,
            prov
        )
    spectra_list[[i]] <- sp
}

```

```{r}

# Check that all mzML files have been read

length(spectra_list)
sapply(
    spectra_list,
    length
)


```

###############################################################
# 13. Build the compound annotation table
###############################################################

```{r}

# Create a copy of the compound table (provenance)
compound_table <- provenance

# Add the compound_id, internal identifier for CompDb
compound_table$compound_id <- seq_len(nrow(compound_table))

# Reorganize the columns in the compound table
compound_table <-
    compound_table |>
    dplyr::select(
        compound_id,
        compound,
        molecular_formula,
        target_InChIKey,
        inchikey_2d,
        sirius_structure,
        everything()
    )

compound_table <- compound_table |>
    dplyr::rename(
        name = compound,
        formula = molecular_formula,
        inchikey = target_InChIKey
    )

compound_table$inchi <- NA_character_

compound_table$exactmass <- NA_real_

compound_table$synonyms <- compound_table$sirius_structure

compound_table$compound_id <- as.character(compound_table$compound_id)

# Reorganize and check
required <- c(
    "compound_id",
    "name",
    "inchi",
    "inchikey",
    "formula",
    "exactmass",
    "synonyms"
)

setdiff(required, colnames(compound_table))

head(compound_table)

```

###############################################################
# 14. Build the MS/MS table (the table that `createCompDb()` expects)
###############################################################

```{r}

# Adding basic columns
msms_spectra <-
    data.frame(
        compound_id =
            compound_table$compound_id,
        precursor_mz =
            compound_table$precursor_mz_med,
        collision_energy =
            compound_table$collision_energy,
        polarity =
            compound_table$polarity,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

# Adding mz
msms_spectra$mz <-
    as.list(
        mz(ring_trial_spectra)
    )

# Adding intensities
msms_spectra$intensity <-
    as.list(
        intensity(ring_trial_spectra)
    )

# Check
str(msms_spectra)

# Corrections
msms_spectra <- msms_spectra |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        spectrum_id = dplyr::row_number(),
        compound_id = as.character(compound_id),
        polarity = dplyr::case_when(
            polarity %in% c("+", "positive", "Positive", "pos") ~ 1L,
            polarity %in% c("-", "negative", "Negative", "neg") ~ 0L,
            TRUE ~ NA_integer_
        )
    )

# Check
str(msms_spectra)

```

###############################################################
# 15. Validate input tables (compound and MS/MS spectra tables)
###############################################################

```{r}

# Number of compounds
cat("Number of compound entries:",
    nrow(compound_table),
    "\n")

# Number of MS/MS spectra
cat("Number of MS/MS spectra:",
    nrow(msms_spectra),
    "\n")

# Mapping
stopifnot(
    nrow(msms_spectra) ==
        length(ring_trial_spectra)
)

stopifnot(
    identical(
        compound_table$compound_id,
        msms_spectra$compound_id
    )
)

# Peak consistency
stopifnot(
    length(msms_spectra$mz) ==
        length(msms_spectra$intensity)
)

stopifnot(
    all(
        lengths(msms_spectra$mz) ==
        lengths(msms_spectra$intensity)
    )
)

# Empty spectra (the output should be 0)
empty_spectra <-
    which(
        lengths(msms_spectra$mz) == 0
    )

length(empty_spectra)

# Missing precursor m/z
sum(
    is.na(
        msms_spectra$precursor_mz
    )
)

# Missing collision energy
sum(
    is.na(
        msms_spectra$collision_energy
    )
)

# Missing polarity
sum(
    is.na(
        msms_spectra$polarity
    )
)

```

###############################################################
# 16. Create metadata
###############################################################

```{r}

metadata <- make_metadata(
    source = "HUMAN Ring Trial",
    source_version = "MetaSci Library (Human Metabolites) - 0.1",
    source_date = format(Sys.Date()),
    organism = "Hsapiens",
    url = "https://github.com/philouail/HUMAN_Ring_Trial"
)

metadata

```

###############################################################
# 17. Create output directory
###############################################################

```{r}

output_dir <-
    file.path(
        library_dir,
        "CompDb"
    )

if(!dir.exists(output_dir))
    dir.create(
        output_dir,
        recursive = TRUE
    )

db_file <-
    file.path(
        output_dir,
        "RingTrial.sqlite"
    )

if(file.exists(db_file))
    file.remove(db_file)

```

###############################################################
# 18. Create the CompDb database
###############################################################

```{r}

db_file <-
    createCompDb(
        x = compound_table,
        msms_spectra = msms_spectra,
        metadata = metadata,
        path = output_dir,
        dbFile = "RingTrial.sqlite"
    )

cat("Database written to:\n")
cat(db_file, "\n")

```

###############################################################
# 19. Load the CompDb database
###############################################################

```{r}

ring_trial_db <- CompDb(db_file)

ring_trial_db

```

###############################################################
# 20. Validate the CompDb
###############################################################

```{r}

# Metadata
metadata(ring_trial_db)

# Available variables
compoundVariables(ring_trial_db)

# Number of compounds
compounds(ring_trial_db) |>
    nrow()

nrow(compound_table) # should be the same

# Does the database contain MS/MS spectra?
hasMsMsSpectra(ring_trial_db) # should be TRUE

# Load the spectra
library(Spectra)

ring_trial_library <-
    Spectra(ring_trial_db)

ring_trial_library

# Number of spectra
length(ring_trial_library)

length(ring_trial_spectra) # should be the same

# Available spectrum variables
spectraVariables(ring_trial_library) # to check what information has been stored in the CompDb.

```

###############################################################
# 21. Validate spectral integrity
###############################################################

```{r}

original <- ring_trial_spectra[1]
retrieved <- ring_trial_library[1]

# Compare masses
identical(
    mz(original)[[1]],
    mz(retrieved)[[1]]
)

# Compare intensities
identical(
    intensity(original)[[1]],
    intensity(retrieved)[[1]]

)

# Compare precursor
precursorMz(original)
precursorMz(retrieved)

# Compare collision energy
collisionEnergy(original)
collisionEnergy(retrieved)

```

###############################################################
# 23. Plot an MS/MS spectrum
###############################################################

```{r}

example <-
    Spectra(
        ring_trial_db,
        filter =
            ~ name == "5-hydroxy-L-tryptophan"
    )[1]

plotSpectra(
    example
)

```

###############################################################
# 24. Pairwise comparison
###############################################################

```{r}

# As the entire library is stored as a Spectra object, we can use the functions from the Spectra package directly.

comparison <-
    compareSpectra(
        example,
        ring_trial_library,
        ppm = 20
    )

comparison

```

# 25. Save the CompDb
###############################################################


###############################################################
# 26. Future developments
###############################################################

The workflow presented here establishes the basic infrastructure for the HUMAN
Ring Trial spectral library.

Future versions of the library may include:

- additional participating laboratories (e.g. ICL);
- all Ring Trial mixtures beyond the Human Endosome subset;
- additional compound annotations (SMILES, PubChem CID, HMDB, ChEBI);
- instrument metadata;
- chromatographic conditions;
- retention indices;
- spectral quality metrics;
- automatic export to MSP;
- automatic export to MassBank;
- automatic export to GNPS;
- periodic versioning of the library.
